source_en: Documents, sorted by date. Mariam Beridze. I'm training to be a doctor.
Mother sent me alone. She says I need responsibility.
Counting people for the census. She'll know I crossed before you file it.
Why the polyclinic, at your age?
They need hands. They let me watch now. Nobody else volunteers.
I study anatomy after schoolwork. Most find it unpleasant. I find it honest.
Every day. Gray skin, black under the nails. The doctors stopped writing it down.
Someone in my family should be excellent at something. It might as well be me.
